findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_sources, get_changes_since · Private data: get_company_overview, get_statement, get_ratios, get_findings, compare_companies, get_events, get_data_quality, get_snapshot_info, list_snapshots, get_sources, run_buyout, get_relationships, find_connections, get_changes_since, verify_figure, search, fetch · Public sink: get_relationships, find_connections, verify_figure · Destructive: get_snapshot_info, run_buyout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_sources, get_changes_since · Private data: get_company_overview, get_statement, get_ratios, get_findings, compare_companies, get_events, get_data_quality, get_snapshot_info, list_snapshots, get_sources, run_buyout, get_relationships, find_connections, get_changes_since, verify_figure, search, fetch · Public sink: get_relationships, find_connections, verify_figure · Destructive: get_snapshot_info, run_buyout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
